observationsNotFindings: D-294 Decision 1's reading rule is scoped by its own text to a sentence that names another lineage's leftover-join version 'and asserts currency', with four enumerated trigger forms (remains/is the current; the inverted form; 'Cite X as the current'; 'still measure(s)'). The monorepo leftover-join.v4 reason sentence the subject points at reads 'g16 leftover-join.v4 does not steal OBL-CI-ENCODING-RESERVED' — it names the sibling version but asserts non-theft, not currency, so it matches none of the four triggers. I developed this as a candidate SHOULD-FIX against the citation's precision and then discharged it: Decision 1's closing sentence — 'A later successor of X does not, by itself, make the citing join stale, not current, or in need of a successor' — is unqualified by the trigger list and is exactly the proposition the subject invokes. A non-currency mention is weaker than the currency class Decision 1 principally governs, so the custody-at-D-277 conclusion holds a fortiori. The citation is over-inclusive in its pinpoint, not false in its holding.

The subject's warrant recital quotes two of the three semicolon-separated limbs under D-293 Decision 7's 'C5/C6:' label. The unquoted third limb is live file 04's 'same-filesystem atomic rename or a reviewed equivalent' rule, which has no bearing on DR-121 CI encodings. Omitting it narrows the warrant rather than broadening it, and the recital never claims to reproduce the sentence entire. Not a defect; recorded so a later reader is not surprised that the source sentence is three-limbed.

Codex's turn-1 narrowRemedy offered two alternatives joined by 'or' — 'D-293 Decision 7 C5' or 'the C5 limb of D-293 Decision 7's combined C5/C6 sentence.' The landed line uses both in apposition. That is a superset of either alternative and is the exact text the turn-2 review prompt mandates, so it satisfies the remedy rather than departing from it. Recorded because a strict reading of 'or' could be mistaken for a mismatch.

'File 08' is a term of art in this corpus and does not resolve by path prefix. Two files answer to an '08-' name: docs/coop/architecture/08-surfaces-and-topology.md and docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md. Only the second reproduces the digest the review prompt pins, and only the second carries register rows. A reviewer who resolved 'file 08' by path rather than by digest would find no DR-121 row, no DR-G05 caps-deferred cell and no DR-130 disposition, and could report a false MUST-FIX that the Q6 precedents do not exist. I record the collision because the trap is live for the next reviewer, not because the subject is unclear — the subject never states a path.

The subject writes bare 'leftoverDesign' for a partition the artifacts carry at $.summary.leftoverDesign. D-294 Decision 2's mechanical successor test uses the same shorthand ('summary.leftoverDesign, else the obligations with leftoverDesign true'), and both spellings resolve to the same array in both joins here, so the shorthand is corpus-standard rather than loose.

monorepo-ci-contract.v16 also carries reviewStatus AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW, which the subject does not recite. The subject recites status CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED and binds NOTHING, both exact. The omission understates nothing about the artifact's standing and creates no claim, so it is not a finding.

The Decision section now carries turn-protocol bookkeeping ('The unlabeled Codex Stage B turn-1 SHOULD-FIX is landed', the CLAUDE-D310-O1..O4 honesty-work sentence, and the Codex no-identifiers sentence). This mixes cycle metadata into the operative act, but it is the adopted house form: D-306 and D-309 both carry a 'SHOULD-FIX is landed' sentence in the same position, and 'travel as honesty work' appears 67 times in adopted COORD.

Both frozen joins are consistent with each other on the reserved-encoding question: g16 leftover-join.v5 carries an OBL-CI-ENCODING-NOT-STOLEN obligation at leftoverDesign false and its leftoverDesignOpenStanding states 'leftover-design of reserved CI encodings remains on monorepo leftover-join.v4 / DR-121'. The subject's refusal to steal OBL-CI-ENCODING-RESERVED matches what the G16 lineage already records about itself.

D-310 does not appear as a heading in live COORD, D-309 is the last live heading, and the subject asserts last-heading custody only. The append-only adoption the subject reserves is therefore the only COORD effect it contemplates, and it has not been taken.

conclusion: Independent adversarial review of the D-310 turn-2 draft against its own bytes and the live tree. The subject reproduced 917c0d78... at open and again at verdict write, mode 0444 throughout; it did not move. The assigned turn-2 question resolves cleanly: the unlabeled Codex turn-1 SHOULD-FIX is landed in the exact text the review prompt mandates and within the set Codex's own narrowRemedy authorized, it appears at both the Protocol and warrant sites, the broadened 'C5/C6' label it replaced survives nowhere, and no identifier was minted for it. The turn-1-to-turn-2 diff is exactly three hunks, so nothing was smuggled alongside the repair — the Subject, Readiness effect and Reversibility sections are byte-identical to turn 1. Both turn-1 review recitals are exact, including Codex's ten-member shouldFix enumeration, the absence of an id member, the 12 unlabeled ONF strings, and both absent-field claims. All three frozen artifacts reproduce their digests and every value quoted from them is exact, including the six reservedForBlueprint members in order and all four OBL-CI-ENCODING-RESERVED fields. Both leftoverDesign partitions are unflipped. Every register token verifies unflattened (DR-121 OPEN, DR-107 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, DR-118 DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED), both Q6 precedents exist verbatim in file 08, required-now stays 28, and the readiness figures match the five adopted predecessors byte for byte. The branch breaks at D-236 and carves out CONTESTED D-272. Ten named attacks all fail against the bytes. I developed two candidate findings — that D-294 Decision 1's enumerated currency triggers do not textually reach the g16 leftover-join.v4 citation, and that the Q6 file-08 precedents were absent — and discharged both: the first holds a fortiori under Decision 1's own closing sentence, and the second was an artifact of resolving 'file 08' by path rather than by the pinned digest. Both are recorded as unlabeled observations. No MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX survives verification.
